name: ESP32_RepeatTimer
description: RepeatTimer: a timer at 1 MHz with a 1 s auto-reload alarm, its ISR giving a semaphore the loop prints from, with millis() as the ISR saw it; the board's Boot button (IO0) pressed at 3.5 s ends the timer, so there is no fourth. The alarms come at 1006, 2006 and 3006 ms of millis(): setup starts the timer 6 ms after the clock millis() reads began, later than on the C3.

expect.contains:
onTimer no. 2 at 2006 ms
onTimer no. 3 at 3006 ms
